name: cross-platform-ai-assistant
description: Cross-platform AI assistant: Node.js agent service with LLM tool calling, React web and Kotlin Android clients, event-sourced conversations synchronized across devices with mid-stream resume.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/protocol && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
